changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO permission_group (name, description) SELECT CONCAT('Imported permissions for account ', a.id), 'Merged from previously assigned groups' FROM account a WHERE a.role = 'USER' AND ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT apg.group_id) FROM account_permission_group apg JOIN permission_group pg ON pg.id = apg.group_id WHERE apg.account_id = a.id AND pg.name <> 'Quản trị toàn quyền' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM group_permission gp JOIN permission p ON p.id = gp.permission_id WHERE gp.group_id = pg.id AND p.code = 'PERMISSION_MANAGE' ) ) > 1

INSERT INTO group_permission (group_id, permission_id) SELECT merged.id, gp.permission_id FROM account a JOIN account_permission_group apg ON apg.account_id = a.id JOIN permission_group original_group ON original_group.id = apg.group_id JOIN group_permission gp ON gp.group_id = original_group.id JOIN permission p ON p.id = gp.permission_id JOIN permission_group merged ON merged.name = CONCAT('Imported permissions for account ', a.id) WHERE a.role = 'USER' AND original_group.name <> 'Quản trị toàn quyền' AND p.code <> 'PERMISSION_MANAGE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM group_permission restricted_gp JOIN permission restricted_permission ON restricted_permission.id = restricted_gp.permission_id WHERE restricted_gp.group_id = original_group.id AND restricted_permission.code = 'PERMISSION_MANAGE' ) AND ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT eligible.group_id) FROM account_permission_group eligible JOIN permission_group eligible_group ON eligible_group.id = eligible.group_id WHERE eligible.account_id = a.id AND eligible_group.name <> 'Quản trị toàn quyền' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM group_permission admin_gp JOIN permission admin_permission ON admin_permission.id = admin_gp.permission_id WHERE admin_gp.group_id = eligible_group.id AND admin_permission.code = 'PERMISSION_MANAGE' ) ) > 1 GROUP BY merged.id, gp.permission_id

UPDATE account a SET permission_group_id = ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT apg.group_id) > 1 THEN (SELECT merged.id FROM permission_group merged WHERE merged.name = CONCAT('Imported permissions for account ', a.id)) ELSE MIN(apg.group_id) END FROM account_permission_group apg JOIN permission_group pg ON pg.id = apg.group_id WHERE apg.account_id = a.id AND pg.name <> 'Quản trị toàn quyền' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM group_permission gp JOIN permission p ON p.id = gp.permission_id WHERE gp.group_id = pg.id AND p.code = 'PERMISSION_MANAGE' ) ) WHERE a.role = 'USER'
UPDATE account a SET permission_group_id = ( SELECT MIN(pg.id) FROM permission_group pg WHERE pg.name = 'Quản trị toàn quyền' ) WHERE a.role = 'ADMIN'
